title: Classic NPC combat XP sharing correction
classification: STRONG for active-combat eligibility and integer quotient; UNKNOWN for nonzero remainder disposition

findings.claim: NPC kill XP eligibility is based on characters actively in combat with that exact NPC when it dies, not party membership.
Each observed eligible combatant receives the integer quotient total_npc_xp / active_combatant_count.
The leftover point does not go to the highest-damage participant or necessarily to the killing-blow participant.
findings.evidence: In the retained-era walkthrough, the recorded follower dealt 115+219 damage versus the leader's much smaller physical/scorch damage, landed the fatal blow, and still received 262 from a retained 525-XP ju-ju zombie.

findings.claim: Exact destination/disposition of a nonzero remainder remains unresolved.
findings.runtime_policy: do not allocate the remainder until native recipient/disposition is proven; record it in character audit conditions

findings.claim: Race/class EXP percentages are experience-cost modifiers and are not multipliers on monster XP earned.
findings.evidence: Official race help describes races as balanced by EXP cost; observed shared monster award matches raw integer division.

sources.observation: race EXP is described as EXP cost

sources.status: symbol identified but implementation TODO; not used as formula proof

split NPC ExperienceReward by active combatant count using integer division
award quotient directly to each eligible character
end that NPC combat for every eligible participant
